title: Staggered rock garden
description: Filtered scan-derived ground plus explicit fixed stone solids.

terrain_friction.status: Estimated rigid contact; inherited backend settings

source.filter: 5x5 median (40 mm), Gaussian sigma 1.5 pixels (12 mm); 25 mm bilinear output
source.microrelief: Three deterministic sinusoids; summed amplitude bound 4 mm before level scaling
source.height_transform: Subtract composed minimum and scale linearly to each requested relief; no height clipping
source.layout: Four rotated measured 4.4 m patches, 0.8 m cosine overlap, new 8x8 m layout. Not the paper layout.
source.coordinate_convention: Array row increases with source odom Y; columns with X, following upstream StaticMap.world_to_grid.

generation.stones: Explicit closed convex polyhedra with vertical sides, beveled tops and small top tilts
generation.grid_role: Projected upper envelope for spawn and route visuals only; collision_vertices/faces are authoritative for physical support

limitations: New synthetic stone layouts; not a reconstruction of GMU arena.
Fixed rigid rocks; no granular motion, soil sinkage or tire compliance.
Local step heights are engineering test choices, not established traversal limits.
Current vehicle configurations differ in radius, mass and bearing parameters.
